title: Stable and Renewable: Assessing the Reliability of a Fully Renewable European Energy System
summary: The transformation of the energy system has raised concerns about the reliability of fully renewable energy systems. We address this question for a 2050 European energy system using an economically optimal adequacy assessment. Our results show that a cost-optimal, fully renewable European system can be as reliable as a fossil-based one, with an average loss of load of only 0.03% due to variability in renewable generation.
